text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (November 19, 2025) for 451 Queen Street East.

The Property Standards Committee, Toronto and East York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (November 19, 2025) for 451 Queen Street East, Folder No. 25 255618 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension of time to February 27, 2026 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
